notes.title: Project Is Now Called HIDENGEN
notes.notes:
[p]I’ve decided to rename the project. What was previously known as [i]Stalk and Strike[/i] is now officially called [b]HIDENGEN[/b].[/p][p]This wasn’t an easy decision, but a necessary one. The old name had an unfortunate overlap with a different, unreleased project that carried some negative baggage. I wanted to avoid confusion and give the game a fresh start — one that better reflects its identity and atmosphere.[/p][p]Nothing else is changing.
The world, the gameplay, the vision — it’s all still here. Only the name is new.[/p][p]Over the next few days, you’ll see updated visuals, branding, and titles across the Steam page. But behind the name [b]HIDENGEN[/b], it’s still the same dark sci-fi world full of danger, vertical movement, jetpacks, and mystery.[/p][p]Thanks for being here. More is coming soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Alexander Boiko[/p]
